sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).
Attenzione: l'audit riguarda il fornitore, non le singole parti.

findings.why: Lifting the probation (EML-SQ-2026-1105, 2026-11-05) restores supplier standing only. It does not approve any part. The approved source list covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL for Alluminio B only. Meccanica C has no approval for BR-220 (its approvals are BR-180 and BR-310). The BR-180 approval does not carry over to BR-220.
